title: Sinensetin ameliorates osteoarthritis progression by modulating the NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling pathway and suppressing chondrocyte pyroptosis.
authors: Liu, Zhendong; Liu, Ruizhou; Yue, Hongwei; Liu, Peilai; Wang, Rui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然黄酮Sinensetin通过NF-kappaB/NLRP3通路抑制软骨细胞焦亡改善骨关节炎，核心为炎症信号通路与疾病表型，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Sinensetin (SIN) is a natural flavonoid with potential anti‑inflammatory effects. This study investigated whether SIN ameliorates osteoarthritis (OA) and explored its underlying mechanisms. In vitro, SIN (0.05-1 mug/mL) protected human OA chondrocytes from IL‑1beta‑induced viability loss. Transcriptome sequencing and molecular docking identified SERPINA3 as a candidate target of SIN. SIN reduced the expression of NLRP3, GSDMD, and ASC, inhibited pyroptotic morphology, decreased TUNEL‑positive cells and LDH release, and lowered IL‑1beta and IL‑18 secretion in IL‑1beta‑treated chondrocytes. Knockdown of SERPINA3 reversed these effects, suggesting that SIN acts through SERPINA3 to inhibit the NLRP3 inflammasome. In a rat DMM‑induced OA model, SIN (20 mg/kg/day for 6 weeks) alleviated pain, reduced OARSI scores, improved cartilage matrix staining (Safranin O, Masson's trichrome), attenuated synovial hyperplasia and posterior capsule adhesions, and decreased plasma IL‑1beta and IL‑18 levels. Western blot of rat cartilage confirmed that SIN suppressed GSDMD and NLRP3 expression. These results indicate that SIN ameliorates OA progression by inhibiting SERPINA3‑mediated NF‑kappaB/NLRP3‑driven chondrocyte pyroptosis. SIN may be a potential therapeutic candidate for OA.
abstract_zh: 辛内酯素（Sinensetin, SIN）是一种具有潜在抗炎作用的天然黄酮类化合物。本研究探讨了SIN是否能改善骨关节炎（osteoarthritis, OA）并探索其潜在机制。在体外实验中，SIN（0.05-1 μg/mL）保护人OA软骨细胞免受IL-1β诱导的活力丧失。转录组测序和分子对接将SERPINA3鉴定为SIN的候选靶点。SIN降低了NLRP3、GSDMD和ASC的表达，抑制了焦亡形态，减少了TUNEL阳性细胞和LDH释放，并降低了IL-1β处理软骨细胞中IL-1β和IL-18的分泌。敲低SERPINA3逆转了这些效应，表明SIN通过SERPINA3抑制NLRP3炎症小体。在大鼠DMM诱导的OA模型中，SIN（20 mg/kg/天，持续6周）缓解了疼痛，降低了OARSI评分，改善了软骨基质染色（Safranin O、Masson三色染色），减轻了滑膜增生和后囊粘连，并降低了血浆IL-1β和IL-18水平。大鼠软骨的Western blot分析证实SIN抑制了GSDMD和NLRP3的表达。这些结果表明，SIN通过抑制SERPINA3介导的NF-κB/NLRP3驱动的软骨细胞焦亡来改善OA进展。SIN可能是OA的潜在治疗候选药物。
